title: EvoViM: Recursively Self-Evolving Visual Agents for Exploration with Deferred Queries
abstract: arXiv:2611.28574v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Multimodal large language model (MLLM) agents have shown promising capabilities in task-oriented environments. However, they still struggle when queries are deferred until after exploration, requiring them to retain visual evidence before knowing which details will matter. We introduce EvoViM, a recursively self-evolving framework in which a frozen multimodal model turns its own interaction experience into one visual program for memory and skills. The program retains images and computes directly on pixels, and its operations decide how this evidence is used in each task. During memory evolution, the same model traces failures in its visual trajectories to the operations that lost or misused evidence and revises them. It also rewrites the notes and analysis tools that guide later revisions, which then build on earlier findings and skip changes that have already failed. translated_title: EvoViM：面向延迟查询探索的递归自我进化视觉智能体
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLM）智能体在任务导向环境中已展现出令人期待的能力。然而，当查询被延迟到探索结束之后才给出时，它们仍然表现不佳——这要求智能体在尚不知道哪些细节会变得重要之前，就预先保留视觉证据。我们提出了EvoViM，一个递归自我进化的框架，其中冻结的多模态模型将自身的交互经验转化为用于记忆和技能的视觉程序。该程序保留图像并直接在像素上进行计算，其操作决定了这些证据在每个任务中如何被使用。在记忆进化过程中，同一模型会追踪其视觉轨迹中的失败，定位到丢失或误用证据的具体操作并加以修正。它还会重写指导后续修订的笔记和分析工具，从而使后续修改建立在已有发现之上，并跳过已经失败过的更改。我们在涵盖六项任务的基准上，使用三个多模态模型对EvoViM进行了评估。
tldr: EvoViM提出一种递归自我进化框架，让冻结的多模态模型将交互经验转化为可直接在像素上计算的视觉程序，并通过自我追踪失败、修正证据处理操作来应对查询延迟的探索任务。
en_tdlr: EvoViM introduces a recursively self-evolving framework in which a frozen multimodal model distills its interaction experience into pixel-level visual programs and iteratively traces and fixes its own evidence-handling failures to tackle exploration with deferred queries.
